name: Edit Jira Issue
description: Updates fields on an existing Jira issue (summary, description, priority, labels). Use to edit, update, or change an issue's fields. For status changes use the transition skill; for assignment use the assign skill.
author: anything-jira

input.hint: Base URL of your Jira Server / Data Center instance.
Jira Data Center Personal Access Token. Sent as a Bearer token. Stored locally in this skill's plugin.json.

issueKey.description: The Jira issue key to edit, e.g. 'ENG-123'. Required.

description.description: New description (replaces the existing one). Optional.

labels.description: Comma-separated labels to SET on the issue (replaces existing labels). Optional.
